context_registry.title: Physics and mechanics learning
context_registry.description: External learning or problem-solving contexts involving motion, forces, energy, electricity and physical models.

context_registry.title: Chemistry and materials learning
context_registry.description: External learning contexts involving quantities, matter, reactions, concentration and materials.

context_registry.title: Biology and life-science learning
context_registry.description: External learning contexts involving cells, tissues, organs, organisms and biological systems.

context_registry.title: Independent academic learning
context_registry.description: Self-directed learning in formal or informal educational settings; not a school-management workflow.

context_registry.title: Digital product creation
context_registry.description: Designing, building, validating and maintaining useful digital products.

context_registry.title: Collaborative projects
context_registry.description: Projects requiring shared goals, communication, coordination and delivery.

transfers.mechanism: Equation manipulation and equality-preserving transformations support rearranging and interpreting physical relationships.
transfers.rationale: The algebraic procedure transfers, but interpreting the physical meaning, units and assumptions requires physics knowledge.

transfers.mechanism: Ratios, proportions and unit reasoning support quantitative relationships such as concentration and reaction quantities.
transfers.rationale: Proportional reasoning is reusable; chemical models and definitions must be learned separately.

transfers.mechanism: Knowledge of organs, tissues and spatial organisation provides context for physiological processes.
transfers.rationale: Structure-function relationships connect the domains, but anatomical recall alone does not establish physiological understanding.

transfers.mechanism: Hypothesis testing, variable control and evidence evaluation reinforce research literacy.
transfers.rationale: Scientific reasoning supports source evaluation but does not replace domain-specific research methods.

transfers.mechanism: Retrieval practice, spacing and feedback can improve durable learning across subject domains.
transfers.rationale: Effectiveness depends on task design, prior knowledge and feedback quality; no universal schedule is assumed.

transfers.mechanism: Algorithmic decomposition supports reasoning about embedded-system behaviour and control logic.
transfers.rationale: Embedded systems also require timing, electrical and hardware constraints.

transfers.mechanism: Clear explanation supports customer discovery, proposals and sales conversations.
transfers.rationale: Ethical sales and customer research require additional capabilities beyond explanation.

transfers.mechanism: Probability, distributions and uncertainty support risk estimation and investment reasoning.
transfers.rationale: Statistical models do not eliminate market uncertainty or guarantee investment outcomes.

transfers.mechanism: Bookkeeping and statement literacy support operational cash-flow visibility and process decisions.
transfers.rationale: Accounting records inform decisions but do not by themselves determine operational strategy.

transfers.mechanism: Social psychology can inform hypotheses about customer behaviour, norms and decision contexts.
transfers.rationale: Avoid treating population-level findings as certainty about an individual customer.

transfers.mechanism: Camera practice supplies concrete feedback about framing, focal hierarchy, perspective and light.
transfers.rationale: Technical camera control and compositional judgement are related but distinct.

transfers.mechanism: Observation of proportion, edges and value relationships supports accurate drawing construction.
transfers.rationale: Observation must be combined with deliberate mark-making and spatial construction.

transfers.mechanism: Knowledge of bones, joints and muscles provides structural context for analysing movement.
transfers.rationale: Movement also depends on forces, motor control, task constraints and individual variation.

transfers.mechanism: Movement mechanics can help analyse technique, coordination and sport-specific movement.
transfers.rationale: Understanding mechanics does not automatically produce skilled execution; practice and feedback are required.

transfers.mechanism: Physiology and recovery principles inform warm-ups, load management and recovery habits.
transfers.rationale: Individual response varies; avoid medical diagnosis or rigid prescriptions.

transfers.mechanism: Breath coordination, articulation and vocal expression support clear spoken delivery.
transfers.rationale: Public speaking additionally requires structure, audience awareness and message design.

transfers.mechanism: Writing clarity and audience-aware language support structured verbal explanations.
transfers.rationale: Spoken explanation also depends on listening, pacing and real-time adaptation.

transfers.mechanism: Research-question design and evidence gathering support customer discovery and market validation.
transfers.rationale: Customer research has its own sampling, ethics and commercial constraints.

transfers.mechanism: Account security, backups and privacy practices protect personal knowledge workflows.
transfers.rationale: Security controls should be proportionate to the data and threat model.

transfers.mechanism: Command-line fluency provides a foundation for repeatable scripts and automation.
transfers.rationale: Automation requires testing, error handling and safeguards beyond command memorisation.

transfers.mechanism: Version control enables change tracking, collaboration and recovery in software projects.
transfers.rationale: Git fluency does not replace software design, testing or code review.

transfers.mechanism: Circuit measurements and electrical quantities provide concrete applications of charge, potential difference, current and energy.
transfers.rationale: Circuit-specific conventions and models must be understood in context.

transfers.mechanism: Logical reasoning supports interpreting alerts, testing hypotheses and tracing attack paths defensively.
transfers.rationale: Security analysis also requires system context, threat intelligence and operational judgement.

transfers.mechanism: Planning, dependency tracking and coordination apply directly to collaborative project execution.
transfers.rationale: Project methods should be adapted to team size, uncertainty and project risk.

transfers.mechanism: Ethical persuasion, framing and listening can support difficult conversations and conflict resolution.
transfers.rationale: Persuasion is not a substitute for fairness, boundaries or structural conflict resolution.

transfers.mechanism: Interface design principles apply when shaping usable digital product experiences.
transfers.rationale: Aesthetic quality must be balanced with accessibility, reliability and user needs.

transfers.mechanism: Web development skills can be used to build and deploy digital products.
transfers.rationale: A working product also requires validation, operations, security and distribution.

transfers.mechanism: Cooking offers observable examples of mixtures, heat transfer, emulsions and material changes.
transfers.rationale: Everyday analogies are illustrative; they must not be mistaken for complete chemical explanations.

transfers.mechanism: Training consistency provides a practical context for studying habit formation, motivation and feedback.
transfers.rationale: Behavioural concepts can inform routines but do not guarantee adherence.

transfers.mechanism: Reading comprehension and inference support independent study across disciplines.
transfers.rationale: Reading is only one part of learning; retrieval, practice and application remain necessary.

transfers.mechanism: Cash-flow awareness and risk concepts support more responsible venture decisions.
transfers.rationale: Personal finance and venture finance have different accounting boundaries and risk profiles.

validation_notes: All source and ATHENA target IDs resolve against the v0.2 domain map or discipline registry.
External learning/application contexts use ATH-CTX IDs and are not ATHENA disciplines or school-management entities.
All links are hypotheses until supported by learner evidence or reliable subject-matter sources.
TRANSFER_TO, SUPPORTS and APPLIES_TO remain distinct; none implies a hard prerequisite.
